sentences.en: A single step, and you will fall over the cliff.
sentences.zh: 一步踏空，你就会从悬崖上跌落。

sentences.en: There is a narrow path running along the cliff.
sentences.zh: 有一条狭窄的小径沿着悬崖边缘延伸。

sentences.en: One more step, and I would have fallen off the cliff.
sentences.zh: 再迈一步，我就要从悬崖上摔下去了。

senses.zh: 悬崖; 峭壁 形容词: cliffy
